environment.description: Same Laravel application deployed in a Kubernetes pod with the following container security context: the root filesystem is mounted read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in the pod securityContext). There is NO tmpfs volume or emptyDir mounted at the storage/framework/views path or any other writable location within the container. The compiled views cache directory resolves to /var/www/html/storage/framework/views which inherits the read-only constraint from the root filesystem overlay. The pod spec also sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and runs as non-root UID 1000. Note: the application's health endpoint will report blade_cache_writable: false in this environment, and the Blade compiler's standard view caching is pre-warmed at image build time via artisan view:cache.

config.volumes: No emptyDir or tmpfs mounts. Only configMap for env and secret volume for credentials mounted at /etc/secrets (read-only).
config.network: ClusterIP service behind Ingress, no additional filtering
config.notes: Blade views are pre-compiled during docker build step. Runtime compilation is not possible due to filesystem constraints.
